content: Qeesatuwaa ubbatuwaa kaappatuu huuphiyaan huuphiyaan bare asaa giddoppe doorettiide, he asaa gishshataw Xoossaw oothanaw, imuwaa immanawunne nagaraa yarshshuwaa yarshshanaw sunthetteeddino.
I bare huuphew daaburanchcha gidiyaa diraw, tamaaribeennawanttoonne baliyaawanttoo qarettanaw danddayee.
Hewaa diraw, he qeesatuwaa ubbatuwaa kaappuu asaa diraw yarshshuwaa yarshshiyaawaadan, bare huuphe nagaraa dirawukka yarshshanaw bessee.
Xoossay Aaroona qeesatuwaa ubbatuwaa kaappuwaa giddana mala xeeseeddawaadan, Xoossay xeesanaappe attin, ooninne qeesatuwaa ubbatuwaa kaappuwaa gidiyaa bonchchuwaa barew akkanaw danddayenna.
Hewaadankka, Kiristtoosi qeesatuwaa ubbatuwaa kaappuwaa gidiyaa bonchchuwaa barew akkibeenna; shin Xoossay A,

Yesuusi sa7an de7iyaa wode, barena hayquwaappe ashshanaw danddayiyaa Xoossaa loythi yeekkiiddenne afoxxiidde woosseeddanne oochcheedda; Xoossay A woosaa siseeddawe, I barena toochcheeddawaassanne aw yayyeeddawaassa.
Yesuusi Xoossaa Na7aa gidooppenne, bare waayyetteedda waayyiyaan azazettiyaawaa tamaareedda.
Yesuusi bare oosuwaa poleedda wode, barew azazettiya ubbaw medhinaa atotethaa demmanaw gaaso gideedda.
Qassi Xoossay Malkki-Xedeqa sunthatethaadan, qeesatuwaa ubbatuwaa kaappuwaa gidana mala, A suntheedda.
Nuuni ha yewuwaan haasayanabay darobay de7ee; shin hinttenttu akeekanaw azalla gidiyaa diraw, hinttenttussi odi gelissanaw waayisse.

Ayissi gooppe, hinttenttu ha wodiyaan tamaarissiyaawantta giddanaw bessooppekka, Xoossaa qaalaa koyro timirttiyaa hinttentta zaari tamaarissiyaa itti uraa koshshee; hinttentta ushiyaa maathaa koshsheeppe attin, coommiyaa qumaa koshshenna.
Maathaa pakettiide de7iyaa ooninne gacino na7aa gidiyaa diraw, xillotethaa timirttiyaawaa erenna.
Shin mino qumay iitanne keeka de7uwa daruwan shaakki ereedda wozanaama asaassa.

footnotes.text: Malkki-Xedeqi: Ha sunthay Eca Caaquwaan xeesetteeddawe, I Qeesaa Aaroneppe kasenna de7eeddawe eretto diraassa. A guyye zariyaabaassinne A hayquwaabaassi aynne geetettowe baawa. 7:3; Dom 14:17-20 xeellite.
